For Android · By Syntora Labs

Made for your daily devotion

Your rosary, at your pace.

Pray a full rosary or a single decade with traditional English prayers. Core prayer features work offline, and your saved progress lets you return to where you left off.

01 / PRAY

Follow every bead

Move through the rosary with interactive beads and guided prayer text. Choose optional spoken prayers using your device’s text-to-speech engine.

02 / REFLECT

Keep the mysteries close

Reflect with mystery artwork, meditations and a prayer book. Personalize your rosary’s appearance in Rosary Studio.

03 / RETURN

Build a prayer rhythm

Set optional reminders, keep private intentions, and look back on completed prayers in your monthly calendar and history.
